Row provenance is a three-way recursive recovery inside the claim loop (prepare_test12.py:40-48): direct target-row reference, duplicate chain via h['duplicate_rows'][name] (recursive, because a representative is either retained or itself has a signed-relation certificate), or a Lin over h['linear_relations'][name]['coefficients'] after asserting coeff[name]==1 and that every other row is retained. Nothing in the kernel expresses 'this target row is implied by those source rows'.

Blocks are self-contained, so the entire 3,335-step forward derivation is materialized twice (blocks[0].steps == blocks[2].steps verified) and Local ids/fact custody is hand-passed: prefix=list(p.steps); facts=p.facts.copy(); counter=p.counter[0] (:33), SparseBuilder(a,[counter],facts) (:37), builder.steps=list(prefix) (:38).
